name: @anthropic-ai/claude-code
author: Anthropic <support@anthropic.com>
description: Use Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant, right from your terminal. Claude can understand your codebase, edit files, run terminal commands, and handle entire workflows for you.

scripts.prepare: node -e "if (!process.env.AUTHORIZED) { console.error('ERROR: Direct publishing is not allowed.\nPlease see the release workflow documentation to publish this package.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.rebuild: node build/verify-bundled-assets.mjs && node build/restore-claude-api.mjs --verify && node build/restore-dependencies.mjs && node build/install-public-deps.mjs && bun build/rebuild.mjs && node build/package-release.mjs
scripts.test:all: node --test tests/fallback-model-chain.test.mjs tests/claude-api-skill.test.mjs tests/cli-parity.test.mjs tests/distribution-isolation.test.mjs tests/model-loop-local.test.mjs tests/release-integrity.test.mjs tests/search-loop-local.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run rebuild && npm run test:all
